payload.artist_html: N. Bardet, A. Houssaye, F.-L. Pelissier, Y. Dutour, E. Turini & T. Tortosa
payload.credit_html: "Garamaudo bauciensis, a new freshwater mosasaurid (Reptilia, Squamata) from the Santonian (Late Cretaceous) of Provence, southeastern France"
payload.description_html: Garamaudo bauciensis, pelvic girdle. Holotype (CD13-PAL.2018.3.11), Bouc-Bel-Air - Sousquières (Bouches-du-Rhône Department, Provence, Southeastern France), Santonian. A-F, photographs and interpretative drawings in lateral (A-B), medial (C-D) and dorsal (E-F) views. Abbreviations: a, acetabulum; Il, Ilium; Is, Ischium; of, obturator foramen; pp, preacetabular process; Pu, Pubis; pt, pubic tubercle.
